gaps.explanation: No fund column missing, nothing counted twice. Statement p4 (printed p14) Total Revenues per column vs detail: General Fund 77,575,149 (GAAP) vs General Fund budget-basis schedule p5 (printed p16) Total Revenues 75,259,161 = 2,315,988; Community Betterment 1,270,597 vs budget schedule p6 (printed p17) 1,275,076 = -4,479; Debt Service 8,583,228 and Other Governmental Funds 726,962 are in detail from their p4 columns (= 0); LB840 Funds schedule p10 (printed p53) revenues 39,952 has no p4 column (LB840 is reported inside the General Fund; the notes say so). 2,315,988 - 4,479 - 39,952 = 2,271,557 = gap. General Fund rows, budget p5 vs GAAP p4: Property tax 28,216,188 vs 28,479,317; In-lieu 755,737 + Franchise 560,642 vs Payments in-lieu and franchise 1,293,518; Sales 18,107,365 vs 18,218,892; Occupation 1,249,821 vs 1,311,611; Permits, fees and licenses 9,640,175 vs 1,715,438 + 2,297,024 + 5,474,808; Intergovernmental 12,200,771 vs 14,197,380; Miscellaneous and reimbursements 4,528,462 vs 2,958,190 + 732,142; investment income 896,829 has no budget row. Printed basis difference; adding the GAAP General column would count the General Fund twice.

Per fund: General Fund GAAP p4 Total Expenditures 100,010,469 vs budget p5 Total Expenditures 86,706,155 = 13,304,314; Community Betterment 305,840 vs p6 305,555 = 285; Debt Service 5,818,055 and Other Governmental Funds 872,050 in detail from their p4 columns = 0; LB840 Funds p10 Economic development 61,406 (inside the General Fund on p4) = -61,406. 13,304,314 + 285 - 61,406 = 13,243,193 = gap. The budget schedule prints four function rows only (General services 7,116,164, Public safety 33,305,985, Community development 20,422,567, Public works 25,861,439) and no capital outlay or debt service rows; the GAAP General column prints current 71,201,190 + Capital outlay 27,754,011 + debt service 1,055,268 (545,000 + 402,452 + 105,013 + 2,803). The budget function rows already carry capital spending on the budget basis (e.g. Community development 20,422,567 vs 3,305,631; Public works 25,861,439 vs 23,641,131), so adding the GAAP capital outlay/debt rows would double count. Printed basis difference; nothing added.

Detail transfers in: General Fund budget p5 'Transfers in, net' 1,183,000 + LB840 Funds p10 'Transfers' 750,000 = 1,933,000. Statement (JSON transfers_in 268,239) = p4 Total column 'Transfers in (out), net' 268,239 = General 12,250,200 - Community Betterment 755,000 - Debt Service 11,226,961 (both outs are in detail as Transfers Out lines). The General Fund's GAAP column prints transfers in, net 12,250,200, its budget schedule 1,183,000; detail carries the budget figure because the General Fund's lines come from the budget schedule (adding the GAAP 12,250,200 would give the General Fund two transfer lines from two bases). The LB840 750,000 is internal to the General Fund column on p4 (not a transfer between p4 columns). So the gap is the Total column netting gross fund transfers plus the budget-vs-GAAP General Fund transfer figure plus the LB840 internal transfer: 1,933,000 - 268,239 = 1,664,761. Note: because the General Fund side is on the budget basis, the Debt Service transfers out (11,226,961, p4) has no matching General Fund transfer in within detail; this is how the report prints the two bases, not a missing line.
